# Draft:Poetry Book Awards

----
The international Maya Poetry Book Awards is an annual English language poetry book award given to the best poetry books produced by indie writers, self-published authors or books published by small, truly independent presses. The contest was founded in 2020 by Welsh poet, novelist and photographer Dave Lewis.
It was launched on New Years Day 2020 in Pontypridd. The original website was relaunched in 2026 after a rebrand from AI innovators, Lunim Studios.
The competition's judges have included Welsh poets, Mike Jenkins, Dave Lewis and Mick Evans.
After many years of finding and promoting outstanding poets through the International Welsh Poetry Competition the Maya Poetry Book Awards aim to bring further recognition to those writers who have produced a book-length collection of their work and hope to heighten a poet's profile by offering this new prize.
The contest runs annually and is based in Pontypridd, Wales.
Past winners
*2025 Napier Marten (England), Taplash Meditations
*2024 Lucy Ingrams (Oxford, England), Signs
*2023 Megan Fernades (USA), ''I Do Everything I'm Told
*2022 Rufus Mufas (Wales), Flashbacks & Flowers
*2021 Jenny Mitchell (Brixton, England), Map Of A Plantation
*2020 Jocelyn Simms (France), Tickling The Dragon
